blocks.html: Our Bank offers different types of loan products to its customers. Persons working both at state and also large private enterprises, having stable financial position and positive credit history and cooperating with bank for a long time are preferred.

items: To the entrepreneurs for the purposes of expanding the activity;

To legal entities operating in transport and communication for the purposes of developing the activity;
To the legal entities operating in industry and production for the purposes of expanding production;
To the legal entities operating in construction and real estate for the purposes of developing the activity.

blocks.text: Loans to legal entities and natural persons engaging in entrepreneurship activity

items: Loan is granted to the citizens permanently registered in Baku, Sumgait cities and Absheron district.
Loan is granted for 6 – 60 months’ term.
Borrower makes payments in an equal (annuity) or decreasing (proportionate) manner in accordance with the payment schedule.

blocks.html: Real estate – apartment, individual residential houses or non – residential areas in Baku, Sumgait cities and Absheron district are pledged as collateral of the granted loans. Payments are required based on annuity and proportional schedules on the condition that they can be paid each month.
